name: Danny Quist
biography: is currently CEO and co-founder of Offensive Computing, LLC, a security vulnerability consulting company. He is a Ph.D. candidate at New Mexico Tech working on automated analysis methods for malware using software and hardware assisted techniques. He holds a patent for a network quarantine system. His research interests include reverse engineering and exploitation methods.
